items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: My sister's show. My sister Edna, Benbo, and her husband had a show. So then I left with them, and we was playing all around here in Louisiana.

ctx.x: Mrs. Atkin had a little private catechism school, and most all the neighborhood children attended the school. She used to teach us how to sing and dance. She'd give little concerts on Sundays for the neighborhood, you know, charge 10, 15 cents out in her backyard. They'd build a little, take some wood and build a little platform and get benches and put out there. And most of the whole neighborhood would turn out to see us kids singing, dancing, and go on. And finally, it just got to be such a big thing that…
When you sang at the halls, did they have a band?
